title: MCP server discoverable
question: Can an agent find an MCP server for this site through a documented route?
method: Look for a server card through the routes the MCP Server Card extension and the AI Catalog proposal describe: entries of type application/mcp-server-card+json in /.well-known/ai-catalog.json, a card at <endpoint>/server-card for an endpoint linked from llms.txt or a Link header, and the community path /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json. Pass when a card parses with a name and an endpoint URL; warn when only the community path answers (it is not in the specification); fail when none does. No host probes these files yet (agents are given MCP URLs by hand or through registries), hence the low weight.

title: API catalog
question: Does the site publish an API catalog linkset?
method: GET /.well-known/api-catalog. Pass on an application/linkset+json document (or a linkset parseable as JSON) with at least one item. Fail otherwise.

title: OAuth discovery for the MCP endpoint
question: Can an agent discover how to authorize against the MCP server?
method: For the MCP endpoint found by A4.1, GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/<endpoint path> and /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource (RFC 9728, which the MCP specification requires of authorized servers), and /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (RFC 8414). Pass when protected resource metadata with authorization_servers is found, or when the endpoint answers 401 with a WWW-Authenticate header naming resource_metadata; warn when only authorization server metadata exists; fail when none does.

title: MCP endpoint reachable
question: Does the advertised MCP endpoint answer like an MCP server?
method: GET the endpoint from the server card without a body. Pass on 405 (a 2026-07-28 server accepts POST only), on 401 with a WWW-Authenticate header (an authorized server), or on 200 with text/event-stream (a server on the 2025 revisions). Fail on 404, 5xx or an HTML page. The scanner sends no JSON-RPC request, so this proves reachability, not conformance.

title: A2A agent card
question: Does the site publish a valid A2A agent card?
method: GET /.well-known/agent-card.json. Pass on JSON with the eight fields A2A 1.0 requires: name, description, supportedInterfaces, version, capabilities, defaultInputModes, defaultOutputModes and skills. Warn when a card is found only at the pre-0.3 path /.well-known/agent.json or lacks some fields. Fail when none is found.

title: WebMCP tool declarations
question: Does the site declare in-page tools for browser agents?
method: Informational. On the home page and sampled product pages, look for the declarative WebMCP attributes (toolname, tooldescription, toolparamdescription on forms) and for document.modelContext or navigator.modelContext in inline scripts. Pass when found; a plain pass when not, because the API is a Chrome origin trial and a W3C community draft with no shipping consumer. Reported, never scored.

spec.title: WebMCP (W3C Web Machine Learning Community Group draft)
